writeup.headline: Oil Turn Lower by Lunch
writeup.summary: This morning's big story was Blue Sweep Rotates Money Into Health Care, Financials. The big swing: oil rallied early, then turned around after 10:39 AM and are now lower on the day — CNBC points to “Brent crude oil falls below $100 as Vance blames GOP election defeat on Iran war”. The AI names are up and the average stock is up: stocks are moving together. Defensive sectors are leading cyclical ones, and the S&P has held its gains all session.

themes.headline: Oil gave back their early rally
themes.detail: Down 2.1% at 10:39 AM, now -7.1%. In the news: “Brent crude oil falls below $100 as Vance blames GOP election defeat on Iran war” (CNBC).

themes.headline: S&P has held its gains
themes.detail: Low at 9:34 AM, high at 11:55 AM; +1.0% since the open.
